Topic 3.3: Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ
2. Give Kenyan examples for Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ
3. Practise Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ at school and at home

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: BAPTISM OF JESUS JESUS CHRIST
This lesson teaches Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ for Grade 1 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ above.
2. Explain Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER
